about: What kind of work a paper record describes, under Zotero's names (docs/dev/paper_metadata.md 'Item type'): gamma/item_types.py and frontend/src/shared/lib/itemTypes.js. types is the list in the metadata popover's order, checkable the types a registry can confirm (AI metadata of one nothing tied to the PDF is flagged). normalize reads a stored or received kind, without regard to case: one of types, an old kind (notes, slides, other) mapped, else '' (the old paper too). item_type is the kind a record names, else what its fields imply. Read by backend/tests/test_shared_fixtures.py and frontend/tests/itemTypes.test.mjs.

normalize.note: the old notes kind is a document
the old slides kind is a presentation
the old other kind is a document
the old paper kind names none: the record's shape decides
a kind outside the list names none
a method's name lowercased names none

item_type.note: a publisher without a venue is a book
an arXiv id with arXiv's venue is a preprint
an arXiv id alone is a preprint
an arXiv id with a published venue is a journal article
the old paper kind is read from the shape
a named kind wins over the shape
an arXiv id wins over a publisher
unknown stays a journal article, so it keeps the paper's warning
a prototype key as the kind is no kind
